key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:c/Wait:0:0000
name: scan_entries_and_fill_table
description: Program entry that walks a linked list of entries, keeping the largest value of one field, and then requests a block through the library sized from that value. On success it fills the block with increasing words, copies sixteen words of parameters in and records a handler address; on failure it returns minus one, otherwise zero.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:c/Wait:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_words_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in the base-register block into the buffer whose pointer is passed on the stack, skipping the copy when that pointer is null. It finishes with a library call.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:l/Disk-Validator:0:0000
name: compare_bitmap_pairs_for_mismatches
description: Program entry that walks a range of block numbers and tests the matching bit in two bitmap word arrays, counting the blocks where the bits disagree. It then writes a two-character figure into a text line, using a leading blank for values below ten.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0000
name: zero_twenty_global_words
description: Calls another routine, then clears twenty consecutive 32-bit words in the global data area with a countdown loop. It saves a pointer to the global data and, when one flag bit of that data is set, calls library routines and further routines.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:001A
name: initialize_object_state
description: Stores a parameter value into one field of the object passed in, sets a word field to the constant forty, and points another field at a global variable. It then clears two 32-bit fields.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:005A
name: busy_wait_then_load_resources
description: Spins through a 300000-iteration busy wait, then loads two resources by number into the global data. It calls other routines and, when a flag bit of the loaded resource is set, builds a parameter block and runs a loop of routine calls until one returns a non-zero value.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:020A
name: allocate_tagged_resource_entry
description: Allocates a resource entry sized from a count in the global data and, if that succeeds, sets its state fields and writes a four-character tag into its header. It then either forwards the parameters to another routine or loads a resource from a table and stores the resulting pointers in global variables.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:033C
name: match_name_and_build_list
description: Compares a stored name string against a second name and, on a match, walks a linked list of nodes, allocating and filling one record per node with pointers and values. The records are linked into a list held by the context, and the routine returns the final counter as a short.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0496
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so the listed instructions could not be recovered. The one library call among its listed calls is at vector offset minus 246, and nothing in the code shows what it does.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:05F4
name: copy_block_handling_overlap
description: Copies the given number of bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer, returning at once when both are equal. It copies forward when the destination is at or below the source and backward otherwise, so overlapping blocks come out correct.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:05F6
name: copy_bytes_forward_or_reverse
description: Copies a counted block of bytes between two pointers, returning at once when they are the same address. It copies forward when the destination is at or below the source and backward otherwise.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0692
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: The body is only a return with no work, so the routine is a stub. It was reached once from an unnamed caller and has nothing else to describe.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:069A
name: tokenize_command_line_into_argv
description: Builds an argument vector from a command string by copying a fixed string and the argument text into a buffer, then splitting the text on whitespace while keeping double-quoted sections together. It allocates one pointer slot per argument, stores each argument start, and ends the array with a null entry.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0860
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, stopping after 32766 characters at most. It terminates the result with a null byte and returns the destination pointer.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0868
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying no more characters than the count argument allows. If the count runs out before the source ends, it writes a null terminator after the copied text and returns the destination pointer.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:088C
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies characters from a source string into a destination buffer, stopping at the source null terminator or when the count is used up. It writes zero bytes into the destination for the remaining count, following the fixed-width copy pattern.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:08AE
name: fetch_icon_library_entries
description: Opens the icon library, then looks up a window-related entry and calls two library vectors to fetch values, which are stored into the structure passed in. It releases its handles before returning.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0960
name: call_optional_hook_and_finish
description: If a global function pointer is set, calls the routine it holds, then calls a second routine and returns.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0962
name: invoke_optional_hook_then_return
description: Has the same body as the neighbouring hook caller: it calls the global function pointer when it is set, then calls a second routine and returns.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0980
name: release_resource_table_entries
description: Processes each resource entry through routine calls and then frees the entry table by its size. It invokes optional hooks and, when a flag bit in the global data is set, makes a supervisor call before returning a value from the stack frame.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0A9C
name: free_indexed_resource_entry
description: Looks up a resource entry by index and fails with minus one, storing error code two in the global data, when the index is out of range or the entry is empty. For entries without the flag bit set, it frees the entry memory, clears its pointer and returns zero.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:RESOURCE.DAT:0:0B08
name: switch_current_directory
description: Calls the dos library directory-change routine through the library base kept in global data. The pseudo-code passes no argument, so the directory it switches to is set elsewhere.

name: release_three_memory_blocks
description: Calls another routine, then calls the system memory-free vector three times through a library base kept in global data. It then clears one 32-bit word and returns a 64-bit value from the two data registers.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:PROG:0:003C
name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter held in a register until it reaches minus one, then returns. The loop does no other work.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:HERO:0:0000
name: decrunch_packed_data_backward
description: Decodes packed data by reading bits from a stream that uses a sentinel bit, copying runs of earlier output backward into the destination. It also writes the background colour register, and the decompiler dropped some branches, so the exact codec is only partly recovered.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:HERO:0:0106
name: fetch_next_bit_word
description: Reads the longword just before the stream pointer, shifts it right by one bit and sets its top bit as a sentinel, then returns the result to the bit reader.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:HERO:0:0120
name: read_bit_count_from_stream
description: Shifts bits out of the current stream word, loading the previous longword with a sentinel bit whenever the word runs out, and repeats for the requested number of bits. It returns once that count is exhausted.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0000
name: dispatch_callback_with_guard
description: Sets a busy flag in global data and, if it was previously clear, stores a short value from a register and calls a routine chosen through an indirect pointer table indexed by that value. It clears the flag afterwards, so reentrant calls are skipped.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:047C
name: parse_sound_sample_header
description: Reads the header of a sound stream: a zero first byte fills a four-entry channel table from a bit mask, while a two-value first byte finds the end marker, computes the sample length and picks a playback period from the rate code (163 for 22000, 325 for 11000, otherwise 651). Other first values loop forever, which the decompiler shows as a dead end.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:04AC
name: clear_byte_and_set_status
description: Clears the byte at the pointer passed in, stores the status value three in the structure, and returns that status.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:04B8
name: find_sample_end_and_copy
description: Scans the sound data for the terminator marker, works out the sample length and playback period from the rate code, and copies the sample bytes into the channel buffer when that buffer pointer is set. It returns the status word from the structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:05AA
name: decode_sound_command_block
description: Reads a stream of bytes through a pointer, using a mask from global data to select up to four channel numbers. It writes the selected numbers into a fifteen-entry table ended by an end marker, clears several command fields, and returns a status word from the structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:061C
name: check_bell_and_write_byte
description: If the byte at the pointer is the bell control code and a flag in the structure is clear, it stores 64 minus the result of the next byte times 64 divided by 127 into an indexed slot. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0642
name: store_byte_conditional
description: If a channel mode field in global data is not four, copies the byte at the pointer into a per-channel table at an index-register offset. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0656
name: record_stream_end_or_byte
description: If the byte is the 127 end marker, stores the distance from the stream start as a short in one field. Otherwise it stores the byte value in another field, and it returns in both cases.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0670
name: store_channel_value_word
description: Writes the word passed in the data register into a fixed field of the channel structure, the same field that the byte-recording routine fills.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0676
name: advance_sound_sequence_stream
description: Advances a sound sequence by one step, decoding MIDI-style events such as note on, note off, control change and program change, and handling variable delay counts. It returns a status value when the sequence ends or pauses.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:069A
name: stop_channel_and_mark_idle
description: Clears a global flag, sets a channel field to minus one and sets the global channel state to two, then returns zero.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:06B2
name: advance_channel_state_machine
description: Advances a small channel state machine: state two moves to three, and state three clears a flag and moves to four. Other states count down a timer in the channel and end the sequence when it runs out, returning a value from another routine.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:06CC
name: step_channel_timer_or_finish
description: If the state is three, clears a flag, calls two other routines and moves the state to four. Otherwise, while a flag is set, it counts a channel timer down and finishes the channel when the timers run out, marking it idle when the stop flag is clear.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:06EA
name: tick_channel_timer
description: Counts down a channel timer while its flag is set. When the timer reaches zero it resets it, decrements a global counter and finishes the channel once that counter reaches zero, marking the channel idle when a second global flag is clear.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0714
name: clear_sound_state
description: Calls another routine, then if a global flag is clear, sets a channel field to minus one and the channel state to two. It returns zero.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0738
name: decode_channel_sequence_events
description: Decodes MIDI-style events from a channel sequence stream, dispatching note on, note off, control change and program change, and handling variable delay counts. It calls several other routines and returns a status value when the sequence ends or pauses.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0792
name: decode_sequence_until_wait
description: Decodes MIDI-style sequence events from the stream, dispatching note, control and program events, until a pending delay or a stop event ends the pass. It then saves the stream position and the last event bytes into the channel structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:07A6
name: save_sequence_position
description: Decrements the channel delay counter, saves the current event bytes and the stream position into the channel structure, and returns. It decodes no events itself.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:07AE
name: decode_sequence_with_timer
description: Decodes MIDI-style sequence events until a delay is pending, then counts that delay down or clears it depending on a flag. It saves the stream position and the event bytes into the channel structure before returning.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:07BE
name: decode_sequence_until_end
description: Decodes MIDI-style events from the channel stream in a loop, dispatching note, control and program events and handling delay counts and the end-of-sequence marker. It calls five other routines and returns once the sequence has ended.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:07FA
name: decode_sequence_delay_and_save
description: Decodes MIDI-style sequence events and adds the variable delay values that follow them to the channel delay counter. When the pass finishes it saves the stream position and the last event bytes into the channel structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0810
name: accumulate_delay_and_save
description: Reads sequence bytes, adding each small delay value to the channel delay counter and dispatching MIDI-style events. It saves the stream position and event bytes into the channel structure when the pass completes.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0826
name: skip_sequence_system_payloads
description: Skips the payload of system messages in the family of status values from 240 upward, reading up to the terminator byte of 247 or stepping over a fixed number of bytes. It then continues decoding events and saves the stream position into the channel structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0836
name: decode_sequence_with_system_skip
description: Another variant of the sequence event decoder that skips system-message payloads and dispatches note, control and program events, adding delays to the channel delay counter. It saves the stream position and event bytes when the pass ends.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0842
name: decode_sequence_until_pending_delay
description: Decodes sequence events while the delay counter is zero, skipping system-message payloads. When a delay is pending it counts that delay down or clears it, then saves the stream position into the channel structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0850
name: decode_sequence_note_control_events
description: Decodes the note, control and program events of a sequence stream, adding delay bytes to the channel delay counter, and saves the stream position at the end of the pass.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0866
name: decode_sequence_until_break
description: Decodes sequence events for a channel, leaving the event loop when a channel match or an unknown control value is found. It then saves the stream position and event bytes into the channel structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0872
name: decode_sequence_calling_library
description: Decodes sequence events for a channel, with one routine call on its event path that resolves to a library call at vector offset minus 498. It saves the stream position and event bytes at the end.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:087E
name: decode_sequence_shared_entry
description: Decodes sequence events for a channel and serves as a shared decoder entry, since six unnamed routines call it. It saves the stream position and event bytes when the pass finishes.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08A0
name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns. It has no other work, and three unnamed routines call it.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08A4
name: store_bytes_and_adjust_offset
description: Stores two byte values into the event fields of the structure, then sets the stream position field to the offset passed in relative to the stream start. Four unnamed routines call it.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08BE
name: reset_channel_playback_state
description: Sets a channel field to minus one, copies a saved position into the stream position field, and calls another routine. It then sets a pending flag and clears the delay counter.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08DA
name: clamp_level_and_scale
description: Limits a 16-bit level field in the channel structure to 64, and when the channel flag is clear copies the level multiplied by four into a global field.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:08FA
name: restore_saved_word_and_call
description: Saves a word field from the channel structure, clears it, calls another routine four times, and then writes the saved value back.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0920
name: call_helper_and_set_pending
description: Calls another routine and then sets a pending flag byte in the channel structure.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:092A
name: arm_channel_timer
description: Sets a channel flag byte to one and its timer count to eight.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0938
name: configure_audio_channel_zero
description: Disables interrupts, programs Amiga audio channel zero with the sample pointer, length, period and a volume scaled by the global level, then enables that channel's DMA and interrupt and re-enables interrupts. It marks the channel as started.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0988
name: configure_audio_channel_one
description: Disables interrupts, programs Amiga audio channel one with the sample pointer, length, period and a volume scaled by the global level, then enables that channel's DMA and interrupt and re-enables interrupts. It marks the channel as started.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:09D8
name: configure_audio_channel_two
description: Disables interrupts, programs Amiga audio channel two with the sample pointer, length, period and a volume scaled by the global level, then enables that channel's DMA and interrupt and re-enables interrupts. It marks the channel as started.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0A28
name: configure_audio_channel_three
description: Disables interrupts, programs Amiga audio channel three with the sample pointer, length, period and a volume scaled by the global level, then enables that channel's DMA and interrupt and re-enables interrupts. It marks the channel as started.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0A78
name: set_audio_dma_control
description: Builds a single-bit mask from the value in the data register and writes it to the DMA control register, then writes the same bit shifted seven places up to the interrupt enable register for the matching channel interrupt.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0A90
name: update_four_channel_slots
description: Loops over the four channel slots of the driver. For each slot with a non-zero mode other than three, it takes the next pending value or adjusts its level and period fields, then clears that slot's state.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0AB6
name: update_channel_slots_from_index
description: Continues the four-slot update loop from the current index, applying the same pending value and level-adjustment steps, and returns once every slot has been visited.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0AFC
name: adjust_channel_level_step
description: Subtracts a delta from a channel level field, advances the slot's counter when the level crosses its limit, and moves through the four slots, returning when all are done.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0B14
name: clear_remaining_channel_slots
description: Walks the remaining channel slots, applying pending level adjustments and clearing each slot's state, and returns when all slots are done. Three unnamed routines call it.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0B38
name: write_scaled_channel_volume
description: Multiplies a level value by the global level, shifts the product right by six, and writes it to the volume register of the audio channel given by the index.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0B52
name: set_audio_channel_volume
description: Scales the global level by a per-channel factor taken from a table, shifts the result, and writes it to the volume register of the audio channel given by the index.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0B7A
name: clear_sound_flags
description: Checks four bit flags in a channel byte and, for each flag that is set, calls two other routines. It then clears the byte and returns the saved register pair.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0BD0
name: advance_channel_zero_state
description: Advances the playback state of channel zero. State zero moves to one and records the channel bit of 128, state one clears a counter and sets the mode fields, and any other state copies the sample pointer and two words from the sound block into the channel fields.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0BE2
name: load_channel_zero_sample
description: Copies the sample pointer and two words from a sound block into the channel zero fields and records the channel bit of 128. If the block is in state one it sets the mode fields and clears a counter instead.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0C00
name: copy_channel_zero_parameters
description: Copies a long word and two words from a source block into the parameter fields of channel zero, then records the channel bit of 128 in two fields.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0C20
name: advance_channel_one_state
description: Advances the playback state of channel one. State zero moves to one and records the channel bit of 256, state one clears a counter and sets the mode fields, and any other state copies the sample pointer and two words from the sound block into the channel fields.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0C32
name: load_channel_one_sample
description: Copies the sample pointer and two words from a sound block into the channel one fields and records the channel bit of 256. If the block is in state one it sets the mode fields and clears a counter instead.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0C50
name: copy_channel_one_parameters
description: Copies a long word and two words from a source block into the parameter fields of channel one, then records the channel bit of 256 in two fields.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0C70
name: advance_channel_two_state
description: Advances the playback state of channel two. State zero moves to one and records the channel bit of 512, state one clears a counter and sets the mode fields, and any other state copies the sample pointer and two words from the sound block into the channel fields.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0C82
name: load_channel_two_sample
description: Copies the sample pointer and two words from a sound block into the channel two fields and records the channel bit of 512. If the block is in state one it sets the mode fields and clears a counter instead.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0CA0
name: copy_channel_two_parameters
description: Copies a long word and two words from a source block into the parameter fields of channel two, then records the channel bit of 512 in two fields.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0CC0
name: advance_channel_three_state
description: Advances the playback state of channel three. State zero moves to one and records the channel bit of 1024, state one clears a counter and sets the mode fields, and any other state copies the sample pointer and two words from the sound block into the channel fields.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0CD2
name: load_channel_three_sample
description: Copies the sample pointer and two words from a sound block into the channel three fields and records the channel bit of 1024. If the block is in state one it sets the mode fields and clears a counter instead.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0CF0
name: copy_channel_three_parameters
description: Copies a long word and two words from a source block into the parameter fields of channel three, then records the channel bit of 1024 in two fields.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0D10
name: remove_audio_handlers_and_free
description: Restores the four audio interrupt vectors through the system vector routine, then passes the memory block given to it to the system free routine. It makes four vector calls and one free call.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0D6C
name: restore_audio_state
description: Saves two fields of the channel structure, runs another routine and, unless it returns three, sets a busy flag and repeats another routine until the stream position stops advancing. It then clears the flag, restores the saved field and makes a final routine call.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0DA6
name: start_note_from_period_table
description: Handles a note event by storing the note and its velocity in the channel record and looking up a playback period in a note table for that key. It then sets the channel's active bit and period, and otherwise returns the register value.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0DB0
name: release_or_start_note
description: Handles a note event where a zero velocity byte releases a matching playing note by moving it into its release state. A non-zero velocity stores the note and looks up its playback period.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0DC0
name: start_indexed_note
description: Stores a note into the channel record at the current index, looks up its playback period from the note table, sets the channel's active bit and records the note value.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0E38
name: set_flag_and_write_byte
description: Sets one channel bit in the active-channel byte, stores a word into a channel field, calls another routine, and writes a byte into the per-channel table at the given offset.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0E54
name: release_matching_channel_note
description: If the channel is not in its busy state and the stored key matches the byte at the pointer, copies an envelope value from the release table and moves the slot to state four.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0E5E
name: release_note_if_matching
description: Compares the byte at the pointer with the stored key for the slot and, when they match and a state is set, copies a value from the release table and moves the slot to state four.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:0E9A
name: initialize_audio_channels
description: Allocates the audio channel control blocks, copies an eight-word table from global data into the first block, clears flags and stores global pointers into the channel structures. It then installs the four audio interrupt handlers through the system vectors.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:10C8
name: fill_voice_record_for_channel
description: Fills the voice record for a channel from its sound data, setting the sample pointer, period, length and envelope values and marking the channel active. When the driver is in its alternate mode it fills a fixed set of envelope values instead.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:11C6
name: initialize_sound_channel
description: Writes fixed envelope and volume defaults into a channel's voice record, copies one byte from the sound data into the channel state, and marks the channel active.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:126E
name: reset_voice_record_for_channel
description: Clears the voice record for a channel, sets its sample pointer and period from the sound block, and sets its volume to the global level plus twelve, limited to 64. Only the mode-one path sets the start value.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron][a]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron][a].adf:AMIGASND.DRV:0:12C2
name: initialize_sound_driver_state
description: Copies one field to another inside the structure, sets a state word to three, copies a sound-block word into a field, and sets its volume to the global level plus twelve, limited to 64.

description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in the base-register block into the buffer whose pointer is passed on the stack, skipping the copy when that pointer is null. It finishes with a library call.

name: clear_forty_longs_and_link
description: Clears forty consecutive 32-bit words in a table selected by an index passed on the stack, stores the address of the stack frame and a global variable into two fields after the block, then calls another routine.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:c/RunBack:0:065A
name: call_optional_hook_then_finish
description: If a global function pointer is set, calls the routine it holds, then calls a second routine and returns.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:c/RunBack:0:0678
name: open_libraries_and_split_text
description: Opens the dos and math libraries by name and, when both open, splits a text buffer into words by writing zero bytes between runs and building an array of pointers to them. On a failed open it reports an error code instead.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:c/RunBack:0:0932
name: run_back_loop_handler
description: Calls another routine ten times, then calls an optional function pointer from global data and, depending on several other global values, calls further routines with arguments taken from those values. It returns the result of one routine call or the original parameter.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:c/RunBack:0:09D6
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, stopping after 32766 characters at most. It terminates the result with a null byte and returns the destination pointer.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:c/RunBack:0:09DC
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying no more characters than the count argument allows. If the count runs out before the source ends, it writes a null terminator after the copied text and returns the destination pointer.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:c/RunBack:0:09FE
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination buffer until a zero byte has been copied, including the terminator, and returns the destination pointer.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:c/RunBack:0:0A0E
name: compute_string_length
description: Walks forward through a zero-terminated byte string and returns its length in bytes, excluding the terminator. It does not change memory.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:c/RunBack:0:0A20
name: copy_bytes_with_padding
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer for up to a count taken from a 32-bit parameter, stopping early at a zero byte, then writes zero bytes to fill the rest of the count. It returns the destination pointer.

key: hero's quest (1990)(sierra)(disk 1 of 5)[cr neutron]/Hero's Quest (1990)(Sierra)(Disk 1 of 5)[cr Neutron].adf:c/RunBack:0:0A40
name: release_indexed_table_entry
